user.title: Set up water monitoring
user.description: Add the first zone and tank. Switch bindings are saved for reference only; this integration does not operate them.

data_description.level_sensor: Choose a sensor that reports depth in m, cm, or mm. Unregistered sensors are tracked only by entity ID, so replacing one with another unregistered sensor at the same ID cannot be detected.

error.invalid_switch: Select a switch entity or leave this field empty.
error.own_level_sensor: Choose a source sensor, not a level sensor created by this integration.
error.level_source_changed: The sensor at this entity ID changed while the form was open. Review the selection. To use the replacement at the previous entity ID, reopen this form and select it again.

abort.already_configured: The water controller is already configured. Use Configure to manage its inventory.

add_zone.title: Add a zone and its first tank
add_zone.description: Switch bindings are optional and are not operated by this integration.

save_tank.title: Tank settings
save_tank.description: Selection: {target}. Choose a level sensor reporting m, cm, or mm. Switch bindings are optional and are not operated by this integration.

data_description.level_sensor: Registered sensors are followed when renamed. If the binding is missing or only its old entity ID was saved, select the intended registered sensor again. Unregistered sensors cannot be distinguished from another unregistered sensor using the same entity ID.

confirm_remove.title: Confirm removal
confirm_remove.description: Remove {target}? Removing a zone also removes all its tanks from this integration. Source sensors and switches are not changed.

error.invalid_switch: Select a switch entity or leave this field empty.
error.own_level_sensor: Choose a source sensor, not a level sensor created by this integration.
error.confirm_required: Turn on the confirmation to remove this selection.
error.level_source_changed: The sensor at this entity ID changed while the form was open. Review the selection. To use the replacement at the previous entity ID, reopen this form and select it again.

abort.configuration_changed: The configuration changed while this form was open. Open Configure again and retry.
abort.invalid_target: The selected zone or tank does not exist.
abort.minimum_zones: The controller must contain at least one zone.
abort.minimum_tanks: Each zone must contain at least one tank. To remove the whole zone, use Remove zone.
